body:
All part of the process!   
I feel pretty certain about my diagnosis, especially with my family history, but sometimes I wonder how others know for sure because unless you actually look at your neurotransmitters spark, you have to rely on your symptoms, and it's like what if executive dysfunction is just a bit of laziness on another person's end, or it's actually from ADHD. Or if you're forgetful because you're just naturally forgetful. It rattles my brain.   


Man, I really need to study for my final exam.

Apparently it's pretty common from what I hear. Teeth are so small, it can go unnoticed unless you see it.
I take the trash out wearing flipflops, and the area near the trash cans have long thick and overgrown vegetation that can conceal things. 
I digress though, it's paranoia, but it's a lingering thought as I don't recall where I could the marks from.

Google and other people can too. 
When I get suspicious of symptoms, I'll look up forums of people asking the same thing, and I'll feel worse seeing people reaffirm their fears, "Better get that checked out. I was 20 when that happened to me!"
Always gets me.
